# Historical MLX Metal library provenance

The standalone Swift app and its precompiled `mlx.metallib` have been retired.
This record preserves the provenance of the library used by that app; it is not
a dependency of the current Electron desktop.

- Source: `https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-swift`
- Revision: `61b9e011e09a62b489f6bd647958f1555bdf2896`
- MLX Swift package version: `0.31.3`
- Minimum deployment target: macOS 14.0
- SHA-256: `cffe8fbfa9cfb794f1d920ff187016f823a555f7814cede99026699a936b92c7`
- License: MIT; see `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES/MLXSwift.txt`.

The historical build helper is available in Git history alongside the retired
app. No current rebuild command is provided here.
